name: The Last Christmas
source:
This is a short Christmas story about a teenager Lucas and his friends. They spend Christmas together every year, but this time something has changed.

[From [url=https://night-vision-games.itch.io/the-last-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于青少年卢卡斯和他的朋友们的圣诞短故事。他们每年都会一起度过圣诞节，但这一次情况发生了变化。

[来自[url=https://night-vision-games.itch.io/the-last-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
